title: Professor Brown's class
scene: Anna's first class this semester is with Professor Brown, who has an old-school way of teaching. He gives the class the syllabus, writes on the board with a marker, says patience is an important attribute of a student, and shows them the campus and the institute.

old_story: It is Anna's first [[class]] this [[semester]]. Her teacher is [[Professor|professor]] Brown. He has an [[old-school]] way of teaching. He gives everyone a paper [[syllabus]]. He writes on the board with a [[marker]]. "Patience is an important [[attribute]]," he says. Then he shows them the [[campus]]. They walk to the old [[institute]] building. Anna likes him a lot. She wants to be patient too.

title: Small talk with exchange students
scene: Anna meets exchange students from India, Ireland and Texas; one speaks Hindi. Small talk is hard at first - there is a language barrier, their accents, slang and dialects are different - and she learns about sarcasm, clichés, acronyms, euphemisms and nuance.

words.ex: Many people in India speak Hindi.
I'm not very good at small talk.
The language barrier was hard for me at first.

I could hear the sarcasm in her voice.
Saying "love is blind" is a bit of a cliché.

"Passed away" is a euphemism for "died."
The English translation lost some of the nuance.
That joke is based on an old stereotype.

old_story: Anna meets three exchange students from India, Ireland and Texas. Priya from India also speaks [[Hindi]]. At first, [[small talk]] is hard for Anna. There is a language [[barrier]], and everyone has a different [[accent]]. Liam from Ireland uses a lot of [[slang]]. Jake from Texas speaks a southern [[dialect]]. When Jake says "Great weather!" in the rain, it is [[sarcasm]]. Liam laughs and says "Time flies," a famous [[cliché]]. Priya writes "LOL" in the chat, and Anna learns a new [[acronym]]. Liam's cousin is "between jobs," a polite [[euphemism]] for no work. Anna understands that every word can carry a [[nuance]]. By the end of the evening, they are good friends.

title: Taras's maths homework
scene: Taras has algebra homework from Mrs. Koval, and Anna shows him an easy method: with a calculator and a formula with pi they find the radius of a circle and the perimeter of a square, and draw a cube, a cylinder and an oval.

old_story: Anna's little brother Taras has [[algebra]] homework from [[Mrs.]] Koval. He is sad because it looks very hard. Anna shows him an easy [[method]]. First, they take a [[calculator]] from the drawer. They use a [[formula]] with [[pi]]. With it, they find the [[radius]] of a circle. Next, they find the [[perimeter]] of a square. After that, Taras draws a [[cube]], a [[cylinder]] and an [[oval]]. "Math is fun with you!" he says. The next day, he gets a top grade.

title: Anna studies online
scene: Anna takes an online course in marketing and keeps a thirty-day streak in her learning app. She watches a video tutorial for each module of the e-learning program, books one-to-one lessons on the student portal, gets a certificate and wants to apply for a grant.

old_story: Anna is taking an [[online course]] in marketing. Her learning app shows a thirty-day [[streak]], and she is proud. Every evening she watches a video [[tutorial]]. Each [[module]] of the [[e-learning]] program has a short quiz. For hard topics, she books [[one-to-one]] lessons on the student [[portal]]. After six weeks, she gets a [[certificate]]! Her teacher says, "You should apply for a [[grant]]." Anna fills in the form that same night.
